name: MiniMax-H3 video with audio on two B70 cards

library.variant: Comfy-Org pruned BF16 denoiser; INT8 ConvRot encoder
library.summary: Owner-approved Comfy-Org published denoiser; one receipted eight-clip batch: 3173 seconds total, 396.625 seconds per clip. Exact scheduling against its own reference. Public runtime rebuild incomplete.
library.public_summary: Make independent video clips with stereo sound on turin: two B70 cards and 15 GiB RAM. Eight clips took 396.6 seconds each on average. The published weights are pinned and verified; clean-build and independent full-suite repeat evidence remain missing.
library.public_caveat: Comfy-Org's published pruned BF16 denoiser (minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_bf16.safetensors): all weights bit-exact with the official checkpoint except the AdaLN tables, which that release replaces with a fitted approximation (lab analysis: below the BF16 noise floor); the 2x result is an exact scheduling speedup against that denoiser's own reference (32 MATCH / 0 DIFFERS, 8 repeat passes). The 800.8 s/clip comparison is a ledger-recorded baseline, raw receipts not retained. No official-model parity claim.
library.quantization: Comfy-Org pruned BF16 denoiser + INT8 ConvRot encoder
library.benchmark_status: Owner-approved measured batch; strict headline certification pending: baseline raw receipts and independent full-suite repeat are absent.
library.public_missing_note: The weights are pinned and verified. This draft still lacks baseline/reference raw receipts, a clean runtime build and smoke test, an independent full-suite repeat, portable path and stop checks, public runtime release assets, and a clean-host replay.
